selection_or_activation_condition: marketplace control over payment is a relevant liability condition
boundary_or_counterfactual: payment for the digital service is made directly to the NRDSP account and is outside e-marketplace control
observed_fiscal_allocation: BIR states the e-marketplace is not liable for the VAT in that case; the underlying service remains subject to the applicable VAT treatment
interpretation: Strong within-regime evidence that payment control can determine whether fiscal responsibility attaches to the marketplace node
nonclaim: Does not show payment control is the only legislative consideration or that marketplace liability improves outcomes

selection_or_activation_condition: platform has online-ordering and payment functions
boundary_or_counterfactual: platform/digital service does not have the online-ordering and payment functions specified for platform withholding
observed_fiscal_allocation: payment-capable platform manager withholds/declares/pays per covered transaction; seller on non-payment platform remains responsible for self-declaration/payment under the specified rules
interpretation: Strong within-jurisdiction contrast linking node responsibility to order/payment functionality
nonclaim: Does not establish that payment functionality caused the reform historically or that the chosen allocation is optimal

selection_or_activation_condition: platform supplies a continuous process comprising offering service receiving payment and delivering service
boundary_or_counterfactual: platform does not satisfy the statutory continuous-process condition for the service path
observed_fiscal_allocation: when the continuous-process condition is met the platform pays VAT in place of the nonresident providers for that platform-mediated portion; otherwise provider responsibility remains relevant
interpretation: Strong statutory evidence that platform liability is conditional on operational control of the commercial process
nonclaim: Does not establish actual transaction coverage compliance effectiveness or welfare superiority

selection_or_activation_condition: formal DGT designation/appointment activates special collector duties
boundary_or_counterfactual: PMSE operational presence alone is not treated in this package as proof of collector status without appointment
observed_fiscal_allocation: appointed PMSE actors collect remit report and issue transaction-linked proof under the designated-collector regime
interpretation: Supports the 'legally activated' part of the fiscal-choke-point definition and prevents operational observability from being equated with legal duty
nonclaim: Does not yet explain why one otherwise comparable PMSE actor is appointed and another is not; appointment criteria/selection evidence should be studied separately
